title: We’re Access Creative College (UK). Ask us anything about studying Games Development & Games Art.
author: AccessCreativeTeam
selftext:
Hi everyone 👋

We’re Access Creative College, a UK creative college offering Games Development and Games Art courses.

We know choosing what to study and *where* can feel overwhelming, especially with so many routes into games (college, uni, self-teaching, apprenticeships).

We’re here to answer honest questions about:

* what games courses actually involve
* workload and expectations
* portfolios and progression
* industry relevance
* who these courses *are and aren’t* for

No pressure, no sales pitch – just here to help people make informed choices.

Ask us anything. 😊

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
